test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said, “I can play the guitar pretty well.”

options.text: She said that she can play the guitar pretty well.
She said that she would play the guitar pretty well
She said that she could play the guitar pretty well.
She said that she plays the guitar pretty well.

solution:
The correct answer is: **She said that she could play the guitar pretty well.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **direct speech** and we need to convert it to** indirect speech.**
 
• When we change a direct speech to indirect speech, we must follow these **rules:**

​ **•** The reporting verb** 'said' **remains unchanged.

 **•** The** inverted commas ("...")** are replaced with the conjunction **'that'** to show the indirect speech.

 **•** **A comma (,)** that is added after the direct speech part, **should be removed** in the indirect speech.

 **•** The modal **'can'** changes to **'could'.**

 **• 'I'** changes to **'she'.**

 
• Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

Hence, The Indirect speech is- ***She said that she could play the guitar pretty well.***
